apiKey.keyFor: an API key for the default DeepSeek endpoint (or another OpenAI-compatible provider); a keyless local endpoint is also possible

evidence.quote: 首次使用时，点击工作台右上角「API 设置」，填写接口地址、模型 ID 和 API Key，再保存。
或本地服务的 `http://localhost:11434/v1`。模型 ID 必须与服务端支持的名称一致；本地无认证服务可以留空 Key。

checkNote: The default endpoint is api.deepseek.com/v1 and the README setup step says to fill in the API Key. The README also says "本地服务的 `http://localhost:11434/v1`" and "本地无认证服务可以留空 Key", which supports local model yes.
